blocks.text: KOKOTANGS 48"/42"/33" Dog Crate Furniture, Heavy Duty Dog Kennel Indoor for Large Dogs, Escape-Proof and Chew-Proof Wooden Dog Cage for high Anxiety Dog, Decorate House as TV Stand, End Table

items: 【Sturdy Build for Longevity】 The indestructible dog cage features thickened iron tubes and heavy-duty wooden panels. Their combination ensures great sturdiness and durability, easily withstanding your dog's daily activities and lasting long without wearing out easily.

【Escape-proof Multiple Locks】Our dog cage is equipped with a robust locking system, featuring 4 sliding locks on the front door and 2 on the side door. Crafted from high - strength materials, these locks are built to endure the most determined attempts by your furry friend.

【Ingenious Double-door Design】The side door is ingeniously designed to be flexibly installed on either the left or right side. It can be freely placed on either side according to the spatial layout of your home and your daily usage preferences, skillfully dealing with various complex spatial scenarios.

【Spacious and Cozy Interior】Both the horizontal and vertical spaces are abundant enough to allow dogs to turn around freely, stretch their limbs, lie down comfortably and fully enjoy their leisurely time inside. Moreover, the spacious space also makes it convenient for owners to place various daily necessities for pets, such as bedding mats, food bowls and toys.

【Easy to Assemble and Transport】With simple construction, assembly tools and easy-to-follow instructions, the heavy duty dog crate is easy to assemble within 20 minutes. In addition, 360-degree swivel caster wheels with brakes make it easy and safe to roll around.

【MONEY BACK GARNTTEE】We are committed to providing our customers with safe and comfortable products. We are guaranteed one year warranty from the date of purchase and lifetime customer service support for rest assured. If there is any problem with the dog kennel, don't hesitate to get in touch with us directly for a free replacement.

【Kind Tips】 When you first start using a dog crate, your lovely dog may feel anxious and fearful due to the unfamiliar environment. Please put chew toys in the dog kennel or do not lock the door in the early stage. Please use the door lock function after your dog adapts to the dog cage environment.
